name: Prism Hero
summary: A full-screen hero with a floating pill navbar, a large headline that reveals word by word, and a bottom-right call to action over a token-based atmosphere.
useWhen: A creative studio, brand or launch page needs a cinematic opening with no photo or video
The headline should animate in once without slowing the page down
avoidWhen: The page needs a full menu with dropdowns, because the pill navbar shows only four links; use `app-interface/navigation-menu` or a sidebar instead
A product screen must show data immediately, because the hero fills the whole viewport
